name: What is fiber cement siding and why choose it for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is fiber cement siding and why choose it for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiber cement siding is a durable composite material made from cement, sand, and cellulose fibers. It is a popular choice for siding replacement due to its resistance to fire, pests, and rot. It also withstands harsh weather conditions, making it a long-lasting option for homes in the Bay Area. Its appearance can mimic natural wood, stucco, or masonry, offering aesthetic versatility. Compared to other materials, fiber cement requires less maintenance over its lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiber cement siding is a durable, low-maintenance material resistant to fire, pests, and rot, suitable for Bay Area homes.
